scripts.serve: npm run build && firebase emulators:start --only functions,firestore,storage
scripts.deploy: npm run build && firebase deploy --only functions:reader,firestore,storage --project koofy-reader
scripts.test:emulator: npm run build && cd .. && firebase emulators:exec --project demo-koofy-reader --only auth,firestore,storage "node --test functions/test/emulator-runner.cjs"
